result.title: Eidetic Code World Model
result.summary: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Paintress，一个代码条件世界模型：用可执行几何代理约束结构与可见性，并用独立参数化的 3D Gaussian 外观记忆保存已访问场景的视觉实现；同时提出 Expedition-33 基准，评测目标离开视野 15/30/60 秒后返回时的外观保持能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「写入与读取分离」——新帧经置信度门控更新持久原始高斯地图、克隆读者副本再全局精修并用覆盖率掩码渲染——可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉证据的保留、更新与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但属视频/世界模型领域，与推理期状态生成的迁移性尚待确认。
